text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I know I've gotta practice, but still... I
don't want
anyone seein' me all weak
like this.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She needs to get reacclimated with
racing in a
pack, but she's struggling to
bring herself to run
with a partner.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I know I gotta run with somebody. But if
I look
weak in front of 'em, I'm done
for...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I'd never live it down. I'd be the laughing
stock of
the academy—of the whole
racin' scene. The
media and fans'd tear
me apart...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She won't budge. Her thorny upbringing
has left
some real scars.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But we're not out of options. We just
have to find
some runners who won't
take advantage of her
weakness...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hello there, Tamtam, I'm here for the
partner run.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Creek... Sorry to drag ya all the way
here. But
yeah, I know I can trust ya...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
But Trainer, you want to help Tamtam
learn to
hold her own in a pack, don't
you?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I don't think I'll be of very much help on
my own...
We'll need at least one more
person if we're going
to practice fencing
Tamtam in.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's right. But I don't know a single
other
student at Tracen who's as kind
and gentle as
Super Creek.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If only we had one more person... Just
one more...
Can I join you?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
You're about to do a partner run, right?
I was just
looking for someone to race...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: O-Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Why, Oguri...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap—a student who transferred to
the
central racing scene from the
regional races. She's
also known for her
voracious appetite.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She and Tamamo Cross share a dorm
room, and
I've heard they get along. But
the question is, will
Tamamo Cross let
her join?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I haven't been doing great in my
scrimmages
lately. The competition
keeps forcing me to the
far outside.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
If I don't step up my performance, I
won't make a
dent in the Twinkle
Series...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I could just go back to my hometown

empty-handed... but I don't want that.
This
summer, if I can just...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oguri... So you've been havin' troubles
too...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross looks straight into Oguri
Cap's
eyes...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oguri... Let's do this. We're doin' this.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Let's go on a partner run—the three of
us! You,
me 'n Creek!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: You're letting me join?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
'Course I'm lettin' ya join. We both got
somethin'
we gotta do. This is no time to
be standin' still.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
No doubt about it! We're gonna find a
way to
smash through all the walls in
front of us!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so the three-person partner running
session
begins.

text_block_list.name: Oguri and Creek
text_block_list.text:
Raaaaaah!
Yaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap and Super Creek sprint ahead
first as
Tamamo Cross waits, eyes on
Oguri Cap.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What's with that form? Trainer,
don't ya
think her body looks a little
low?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A low center of gravity is a trait shared
by many
successful runners. If that's how
Oguri Cap runs,
then she has a lot of
promise.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I've seen that type of runnin' before
someplace...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wait, I know. It's like that big ol' pooch
at the
park...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I used to take my siblings to the
park, and
sometimes I'd see this massive
dog.

text_block_list.name: Big Dog
text_block_list.text: Woof! Woof, woof!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Whoa geez, your owner must be a real

moneybags. Hey, quit dat!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That pooch used to come jumpin' all
over me.
He'd get down low—then he'd
pounce like "bam!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
And it'd knock me over like a bowling
pin each
time. Seein' Oguri like that
brings me back.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oguri doesn't get as low, but if she went
all the
way...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Huuuup!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh?! Tamtam, what are you doing?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Steadying her breathing, Tamamo Cross
stoops
down, lowering her short frame
even farther.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ya think this'll work, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It checks out. The lower she is, the
shorter the
fall.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If we take the pack head-on with this
running
form...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oguri! Creek! Let's get this trio run
started!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Raaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The three runners vie ferociously for the
lead.
Will Tamamo Cross's new running
form make a
difference?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Grrr! Hraaaagh! Whoa, this is new...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I'm holdin' out—I got this! Nothin's topplin' me over. I might be sandwiched in... but my legs aren't tremblin'!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh my, Tamtam...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The results are clear as day. Tamamo
Cross is
running in a partner race without
any fear.
However...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: You're not getting away from me, Tama!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Agh! It's not easy stayin' low for this
long... Gotta
find my second wind!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross has no choice but to drop
back.
The combination of her lingering
fear and the
exhaustion of maintaining a
low running position
are keeping her
from overcoming her physical

disadvantage.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
A new running form isn't gonna cut it... I
need
something else too... Just one more
thing should
do it! One more!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Tamamo Cross struggle, I
carefully
consider our situation. I feel
like we're forgetting
something
important.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We do need to hold our ground in the
running
crowd, that's for sure, but that's
not the reason
we're running. Our end
goal is to win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With her small stature, there's no need
for her to
be jostling up against the
competition for long
periods of time.
Which means...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: White Lightnin'...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... That's right... My secret
weapon... is
comin' in like a flash of light!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I don't gotta fight all the other racers. If
I can
zoom right by 'em... then problem
solved!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maintaining her low posture, Tamamo
Cross
opens up a considerable gap
before launching
into her pursuit—like
an arrow being drawn back
before it
fires.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hunch down. Gather energy 'n then...
Blow pass
all of 'em! I'll seize da win in a
flash!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Check out da new 'n improved White
Lightnin'!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kashaaaaa!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Following the race, everyone is left at a
loss for
words. It's as if nobody can
believe what they just
saw.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Trainer, Tama's running just now...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Trainer, Tama's running just now...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's no easy feat to maintain that posture
while
running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The fortitude of Tamamo Cross's legs has
taken
us from the depths of despair to
dizzying new
heights.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She persevered despite the pain, and
searched
for her own path.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And now, through her sheer tenacity,
she's
stumbled upon a new running style
that'll let her
race without paying the
crowd any mind.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, you two. And thanks, Trainer. I
know
what to do now.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
This isn't me runnin' away from danger,
this is me
findin' a new path to gettin'
stronger. I'll outstrip
everyone 'n blast
ahead!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna train like crazy this summer.
By the end
of the season, my new form's
gonna be second
nature.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I'm never gonna stay put again! Trainer,
gimme all
ya got.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The murky clouds that formed after the
accident
finally clear up, and White
Lightning crackles
anew.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And it's thanks to Tamamo Cross's latent

potential and creativity... as well as a
certain
dream-chaser from the
countryside.
